about: Normison (temazepam, a benzodiazepine) is supplied four times, 28 tablets each, from 19 November 2025 to 8 February 2026 (about 12 weeks), by brand name only.
Nitrazepam (Mogadon) is supplied four times, 28 tablets each, from 21 January to 15 April 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
Temazepam (Normison) is supplied as three separate courses of 7 tablets each, about five months apart, so no run of supply reaches four weeks.
